title: Team Terra — Cheesemakers Seed
scope: Ten selected makers in ten countries across five regions, based on maker-published evidence. Not an exhaustive list or a ranking.

records.name: Cowgirl Creamery
records.evidence: The maker’s creamery page places its Cader Lane production in Petaluma and describes curd making, wheel forming and aging there.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Maker website and stockist locator available; public factory access was not established.
records.highlight_reason: Creamery working with nearby dairy farms.

records.name: Fromagerie St-Albert
records.evidence: Official visitor page places the factory viewing gallery in St-Albert, Ontario; the product page describes the cooperative’s cheese range.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Public visitor centre, factory viewing gallery, shop and restaurant are described on the official site.
records.highlight_reason: A cheesemaking cooperative with a factory viewing gallery.
records.qualification: Use St-Albert, Ontario; do not confuse with St. Albert, Alberta. The Mirabel shop is a separate location.

records.name: Capril do Bosque
records.evidence: Official maker page describes a family goat farm and artisanal cheesery; the published business locality is Joanópolis, São Paulo.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Farm visitor experiences and shop are published; restaurant and picnic booking routes are provided.
records.highlight_reason: Goat farming, cheesemaking and visitor experiences at one producer.

records.name: La Latteria
records.evidence: Official FAQ and foodservice page describe made-to-order Italian-style cheeses produced in London using British cow’s milk.
records.visit_or_shop_note: The FAQ explicitly says the premises are not open to the public; delivery is the stated route.
records.qualification: Locally made cow’s-milk cheeses are distinct from imported buffalo-milk products sold by the same business.

records.name: Laiterie La Chapelle
records.evidence: The dairy states that it makes and matures its own cheeses in Paris’s 18th arrondissement; its workshop and cellar can be seen from the street.
records.visit_or_shop_note: A published shop schedule and workshop programme are available; consult the maker for the current session schedule.
records.highlight_reason: A Paris dairy with cheesemaking visible from the street.

records.name: Dalewood Fromage
records.evidence: The official homepage describes farmstead production from the farm’s own Jersey milk and gives Klapmuts as the published locality.
records.visit_or_shop_note: The cheesery shop publishes opening hours but explicitly says cheese tastings are not offered.
records.highlight_reason: Farmstead cheese from the producer’s own Jersey milk.
records.qualification: City/locality representative point only: the farm lies on the Klapmuts–Simondium road. Homepage identity/location is from the official indexed page after a direct extraction timeout; the shop page was read successfully before a later fetch was rate-limited.

records.name: Eleftheria Cheese
records.evidence: The maker’s about page describes its Mumbai cheesemaking business and milk sourcing from Maharashtra farms; the contact page publishes a Mumbai address.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Online cheese shop and business enquiry route are published. Public creamery visits were not established.
records.highlight_reason: Mumbai-based artisanal cheesemaking with Maharashtra milk suppliers.
records.qualification: Postal contact city is retained; the map must not imply that this contact address is a verified production entrance.

records.name: Fattoria Bio Hokkaido
records.evidence: Official company story describes a natural-cheese manufacturer combining Hokkaido ingredients and Italian cheesemaking; its own factory shop is listed in Sapporo.
records.visit_or_shop_note: The official location list distinguishes the Sapporo factory shop from other stockists. Factory tours were not established.

records.name: La Delizia Latticini
records.evidence: The maker’s about page states that its fresh cheeses are made in Perth; the retail shop is specifically in East Victoria Park.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Public retail shop in East Victoria Park; use its current published hours.
records.highlight_reason: Fresh Italian-style cheese made with Western Australian milk.
records.qualification: Perth is the maker’s published production-city description. East Victoria Park is preserved as the retail locality; these are not an exact factory coordinate.

records.name: Whitestone Cheese Co.
records.evidence: The maker states that its Ōamaru plant manufactures, packs and dispatches cheese; its process page describes open-vat production and maturation.
records.visit_or_shop_note: Guided factory tours are published and bookable; the Diner & Deli is a separate location in the same town.
records.highlight_reason: A working cheese factory with a guided viewing-gallery route.
records.qualification: Official source spells the city Oamaru. The record uses the standard macron form Ōamaru; both names refer to the same town.

limitations: All coordinates are null pending sourced city/locality geocoding.
A maker entry does not imply public access to its factory. Visitor/shop statements are separate.
No maker awards, food-safety certifications or legal entities have been independently audited.
Quesos VAI was researched but deferred because the official-page extraction did not establish a precise municipality sufficiently for this seed.
Retail shops, factory visitor facilities and production entrances are not interchangeable; this layer uses approximate city/locality points.
